tenderSchedule.title: Replacement of Unit-1 &2 110KV conductors, Ground wire, Cross bus conductors and main bus conductors from Power House to ODY Unit bay at ODY, KPCL Ganeshgudi
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer O and M Office KVP Supa

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The bidder should be a Super Grade Electrical contractor and should have experience in Replacement of 66KV or higher voltage level transmission line conductors, connector, insulators and associated or similar work in preceding last five years. (i.e 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25,2025-26) In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work order of value not less than Rs. 20.51 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) awarded by any reputed Industry/PSU/Government organization and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by competent authority (officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre in case of state/central Government/Government under taking and not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL). (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and corresponding work done certificates

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have achieved in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25,2025-26) a minimum financial turnover or average annual financial turnover of Rs.41.10 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in at least two financial years, as a proof of this turnover certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished.(A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of 2026-27).
